name: meshin-co-site
description: meshin.co — Astro 7 static site for a Fractional Chief AI Officer practice

scripts.build: astro build && node scripts/gen-headers.mjs dist && node scripts/generate-static-sidecars.mjs dist && node scripts/search-page-text.mjs dist && node scripts/gate.mjs dist budgets.json
scripts.check: npm run check:astro && npm run check:eslint && npm run check:prettier
scripts.fix: npm run fix:eslint && npm run fix:prettier
scripts.gate:lh: rm -rf .lighthouseci && lhci autorun --config=lighthouserc.cjs && node scripts/collect-reports.mjs mobile && rm -rf .lighthouseci && LHCI_FORM_FACTOR=desktop lhci autorun --config=lighthouserc.cjs && node scripts/collect-reports.mjs desktop
scripts.assets:logo: node scripts/generate-logo.mjs && node scripts/generate-favicons.mjs && prettier --write src/components/common/LogoMark.astro src/components/common/LogoSymbol.astro --log-level warn

localOnlyGates.gate:lh: the CI lighthouse matrix runs gate:lh:one per form factor and route shard; the full local run would be one 30-minute job
localOnlyGates.audit:polish: run-polish-sweep.mjs walks the built dist at six widths with a real Chromium instance and writes audits/phase-5/polish-sweep.md as generated evidence for one phase; it is run manually when that phase is reviewed, not per commit
localOnlyGates.audit:prelaunch: run-pre-launch.mjs reads other phase-5 audit artifacts (REPORT.md, polish-sweep.md) already committed under audits/, shells out to git log across full history, and re-runs the visual and cross-browser Playwright suites; it is the manual pre-launch checklist run once before shipping, not a per-commit CI gate (tracked as a residual gap: docs/plan/reference/known-gaps.md#G3)
localOnlyGates.smoke:prod: run-smoke-prod.mjs makes live HTTP requests against the production origin (default https://meshin.co) and writes audits/phase-5/smoke-prod.md; it can only run after a real deploy, not from a CI build artifact
localOnlyGates.audit:geo: generate-geo-baseline.mjs writes audits/geo-baseline.md, a structural readiness baseline captured once per phase from docs/SEMANTIC-CORE.md and dist, not re-derived every commit
localOnlyGates.audit:geo-probe: run-geo-probe.mjs calls four live external answer-engine APIs (OpenAI and others) and writes audits/geo-probe.md; it is a manual, rate-limited, credentialed probe against third-party services, not a CI-safe per-commit check
localOnlyGates.assets:gaps: generate-gaps.mjs writes audits/phase-4.7/gaps.md from the ledger and registers; it is a generator run manually when the ledger changes, not a gate CI needs to enforce every commit
